newsitem.title: USA: Rep. Gonzalez hails Fed rate decision.
newsitem.headline: Rep. Gonzalez hails Fed rate decision.

text.p: Rep. Henry Gonzalez, the senior Democrat on the House Banking Committee, said he was pleased by the Federal Reserve's decision Tuesday not to raise interest rates.

"Today the Fed made the right decision in not raising interest rates. Monetary policy should not be decided with one finger to the wind. Now that the economy is on track, the Fed would be well-served in cleaning its house," Gonzalez, a frequent Fed critic, said in a statement.
